title: Cover federation onboarding and mailbox route body limits after router composition
outcome: Loopback regressions protect the onboarding 4096-byte request cap and the independently configured mailbox request limit against router-layer reordering.
acceptance: An authenticated loopback request with a body larger than 4096 bytes to an onboarding JSON POST route is rejected with 413 before the probe is executed.
An authenticated valid mailbox request larger than 4096 bytes but below its negotiated mailbox request limit reaches the mailbox handler without a 4096-byte body-limit rejection.
The tests distinguish authentication, parsing and business-rule failures from body-limit enforcement and fail if the relative onboarding/body-limit/mailbox layer order is reversed.
